threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look puzzled when the bus doesn't stop at normal times; locals know the 106's secret schedule.
Last week on the N35, a guy serenaded the whole bus with Whitney lyrics. That late-night crowd? They went from sleepy to full sing-along. Pure Brixton magic.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I found an old lady in the park feeding pigeons while discussing politics with a pigeon enthusiast—it felt like home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a currywurst stand that doubles as a gallery for local artists. It's graffiti and gourmet in one bite.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know which taco truck has the best lengua and that you can order it by name—not just by menu number. It's a delicious club.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a bus today that stopped short in front of a street musician. Instead of moving on, the whole bus stayed to enjoy the impromptu show.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí. They miss the hidden local bars where the real tapas happen, like a secret culinary map.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're new by their wide-eyed look at the Ferias de Gràcia, snapping photos of every corner, while the locals just sip their tinto.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: When you say 'the Tube' instead of 'the underground', you can spot the fresh faces immediately. It's like a secret handshake we just don’t have.
Last night on the 59, a guy was serenading a cat. The cat wasn’t having it, just stared him down. Classic Brixton vibes.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a couple arguing over the last slice of pizza at the Kottbusser Tor late one night, only to see them sharing the next one in a park.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a guy selling currywurst with one hand while juggling beer bottles with the other—pure Kreuzberg chaos.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot 'locals' by their nonchalance at BART delays; they’ve already abandoned plans and are just grabbing a taco instead.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the Muni last week, it stopped for a pigeon that clearly had priorities. Only in this city do the birds halt transit!

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all tapas come with an olive for a garnish. In Gràcia, it's usually a good slice of tomato or a patata brava instead.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their bewildered expressions while trying to negotiate the intricacies of the metro map—it's almost as if they expect it to make sense.
